step_two_text: Check its licence, documentation and status before reusing it.

ospo_text: The Open Source Program Office helps teams publish their code, tracks the licences of the software in use and represents France Travail in open source networks.

reading_guide_title: How to read a project’s status
reading_guide_text: The status depends on the repository’s last update: active under one year, maintained between one and two years, archived beyond. The OSPO adjusts it when it knows more, as for Gabarit or TradOpen. It does not guarantee support.
lifecycle_active_text: Updated less than a year ago.
lifecycle_maintained_text: Last updated one to two years ago.
lifecycle_archived_text: No update for over two years, or known to have stopped.
missing_project_title: Can't find what you are looking for?
missing_project_text: A question, a cooperation idea or a project to suggest? Talk to the OSPO.
